title: Linear independence of vectors with entries in a field is unchanged by field extension
statement: Let $K\subseteq L$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension] of fields [def-weil-field], let $n,k\in\mathbf Z_{\geq0}$ and let $v_1,\ldots,v_k\in K^n$. View $K^n\subseteq L^n$ entrywise. Then $v_1,\ldots,v_k$ are linearly independent over $L$ (no nontrivial relation $\sum_i\lambda_iv_i=0$ with $\lambda_i\in L$) if and only if they are linearly independent over $K$.
